title: Buildables

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

units.description: Unit of every distance in the file.

id.description: The game's buildable id, for example `Id.Buildable.Bunker`.

icon.description: Path of the buildable's icon inside `assets/icons/` (the same folder as the item icons). Absent when the game has no icon for it.

cost.description: Building supplies it costs to place.

repairSpeedMultiplier.description: How fast it repairs compared with the standard rate, when the game states one.

maxStack.description: How many can be carried or placed as a stack, when the game states one.

damageEntity.description: The `entity` of its rules in damage.json, such as `Buildable.Bunker`.

size.description: Size of the finished stage's bounding box as the game stores it: [x, y, z] in meters. Structures built in several pieces (a bunker with a floor and a roof) have a separate entry per piece.

placementRules.description: Names of the placement conditions the game checks, such as `WithinFobBounds` or `SafeZone` (no building in a safe zone).

description: Structures players can build (fortifications, FOB parts, stations): cost, health, size, where they can be placed and how they take damage.
